title: A reminders opt-in sync carries no erase: it rides on the store's erase mark
evidence: Done 2026-11-25 (R5 PR 2): autoEnrolReminders reads getShownErase() beside the opt-in it acts on, and the same-address provider sync writes setReminderOptIn({ ...current, provider }, erase). Test: standalone/reminders-erase-argument.test.ts H18b (real store; an erase and the same opt-in written again while the account lookup is out: the record unchanged; control lands); failed before the fix. Was: standalone/reminders.ts:305 setReminderOptIn with no erase R5 PR 3 (2026-11-25): the erase is a required argument by type on every RoadmapStore and lib/roadmap-data.ts writer, on RecordSession.refuses and .edit (packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts: the fallback default `erase = this.shownErase` is gone), and on the web upload Save's state (storage/upload-save-store.ts WebSaving; the phone's door still omits it). A writer that forgets it does not compile: storage/roadmap-store-erase-argument.test.ts `writersRequireAnErase` (one @ts-expect-error per writer) and its table (each writer under an older erase refused, record JSON unchanged; under the shown erase it lands).
